title: Pager cache statistics accumulation and reset

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerCacheStat selects the Pager hit, miss, write, or spill counter, adds it to a caller-owned accumulator, and optionally resets only that selected counter.
excluded_responsibilities: Incrementing counters at Pager read, write, and spill sites

external_source_responsibilities: Pager read, write, and spill paths maintain the four counters
sqlite3_db_status64 maps public operation numbers and traverses every open Pager
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete selector, accumulation, and optional reset body is assigned; sqlite3_db_status64 consumes it for main and attached runtime Pagers.

inputs: Typed hit, miss, write, or spill selector
outputs: Accumulator incremented by the selected counter
contracts.ownership: No allocation or ownership transfer; only the caller accumulator and optionally one Pager counter mutate.
contracts.state_and_results: The selected counter is added with unsigned wrapping semantics. Reset clears exactly that counter after its prior value is accumulated; all other counters are preserved.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns connection/Pager synchronization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Typed selection removes invalid-statistic runtime failure; the operation is otherwise infallible.

representation_differences: The source accepts contiguous DB-status integer values guarded by assertions; Zig uses CacheStatistic so only the four valid selectors are representable.
The write counter is stored as database_writes and the spill counter as cache_spills in the runtime Stats owner.

oracle.protocol: Produce two misses and one hit through live page acquisition, start an accumulator at 9, consume-and-reset hit to obtain 10 and zero the hit counter, then accumulate miss without reset to obtain 12 while preserving miss count 2.
oracle.normalization: Counter and accumulator values compare exactly as unsigned 64-bit integers.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; connection status callers provide serialization.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid selectors are unrepresentable in the typed production API.
assurance.continuation: Repeated no-reset reads preserve counters; reset affects only the selected counter.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig Pager Stats and src/core/sql_frontend.zig database-status traversal
integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_db_status64 CACHE_HIT, CACHE_MISS, CACHE_WRITE, and CACHE_SPILL traverse main and attached databases and call Pager.addCacheStatistic with the requested reset flag.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The pre-gate internal pager_core.cacheStat claim remains retired with zero credit; this post-retirement runtime method has a distinct path, name, declaration hash, typed selector, and live public caller.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C DB-status counter/reset differential, assurance closure, and independent review.
